newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-NEC REMAIN IN FIRST DIVISION ON GOAL DIFFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEC REMAIN IN FIRST DIVISION ON GOAL DIFFERENCE.

text.p: NEC Nijmegen held on to their Dutch first division status on Saturday by winning Group B of the first division playoffs on goal difference.

NEC, who beat second division side Cambuur 4-0 away in the last round of the round-robin tournament, finished level on points with Go Ahead Eagles Deventer, but had a superior goal difference of five.
It was the eighth time in NEC's history they have played and won the playoffs.
The Nijmegen side finished 17th in the Dutch first division this season.
